contenu:
trigger: none
pr:
  branches:
    include:
      - '*'  
resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: mesx-infrastructure
      type: git
      name: MES_X.0/mesx-infrastructure
      ref: refs/heads/main

pool:
  vmImage: ubuntu-latest

steps:
  - checkout: self 
    persistCredentials: true         
  - checkout: mesx-infrastructure  
    

   

  - task: NodeTool@0
    inputs:
      versionSpec: '20.x'
    displayName: 'Install Node.js'


  - script: |
      echo "✅ Printing PR version of _service_versions.json"
      prVersion=$(cat ./mesx-proto-dependency-management/dep-management/_service_versions.json)

      echo "PR version: $prVersion"
      echo " Running because of a Pull Request"
      echo "Source branch: $SYSTEM_PULLREQUEST_SOURCEBRANCH"
      echo "Target branch: $SYSTEM_PULLREQUEST_TARGETBRANCH"
      echo " PR ID: $(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)"
    env:
      prId: $(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)


    displayName: "Show PR version of file"
  - script: |
          cd  ./mesx-proto-dependency-management
          ls -la
          git fetch origin main
  
          git show origin/main:./dep-management/_service_versions.json > main_version.json
          echo "✅ Main version content:"
          cat main_version.json
    displayName: 'Fetch and show main version of _service_versions.json'
   

  - script: |
      echo "✅ Printing MAIN version of _service_versions.json"
      mainVersion=$(cat mesx-infrastructure/_service_versions.json)
      echo "MAIN version: $mainVersion"
    displayName: "Show MAIN version of file"

  - script: |
      cd  ./mesx-proto-dependency-management/dep-management
      npm install
      
    displayName: 'Install dependencies for dep-management'
    env:
      mesx_infrastructure_DIR: $(Pipeline.Workspace)/mesx-infrastructure
  - script: |
      prVersion=$(cat ./mesx-proto-dependency-management/dep-management/_service_versions.json)
      mainVersion=$(cat ./mesx-infrastructure/_service_versions.json)
      cd  ./mesx-proto-dependency-management/dep-management
      node compareServiceVersions.js
    displayName: 'Run compareServiceVersions.js'
    env:
      mesx_infrastructure_DIR: $(Pipeline.Workspace)/mesx-infrastructure
      prVersion: $(prVersion)
      mainVersion: $(mainVersion)
   

  - script: |
      prVersion=$(cat ./mesx-proto-dependency-management/dep-management/_service_versions.json)
      mainVersion=$(cat ./mesx-infrastructure/_service_versions.json)
      cd  ./mesx-proto-dependency-management/dep-management
      ls -la
      node postComment.js
    env:
      SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN: $(System.AccessToken)
      PR_ID: $(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)
      ORG_NAME: faurecia-cloud
      PROJECT_NAME: MES_X.0
      REPO_ID: $(Build.Repository.ID)
      prVersion: $(prVersion)
      mainVersion: $(mainVersion)
    displayName: "💬 Post comment to PR"

export const REPO_URL = 'https://dev.azure.com/faurecia-cloud/MES_X.0/_git/mesx-infrastructure';
export const TARGET_DIR = './mesx-infrastructure';
